news.headline: Indonesia to raise crypto transaction taxes from August 1
news.body: Indonesia will raise taxes on cryptocurrency transactions starting August 1, 2026, aiming to capture revenue from its growing digital trading sector. The finance ministry's regulation raises the tax on sales via domestic exchanges to 0.21% and imposes a 1% levy on trades through overseas platforms, while removing a special mining tax effective in 2026.
